Turn hours into invoices: billable hours × rate, utilization percentage against non-billable time, and the final invoice total.

For information only — not financial advice. Taxes are not included.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter your billable hours and hourly rate.
  2. Enter non-billable hours too, to get a true utilization %.
  3. Optionally add expenses or a discount.
  4. Press Calculate for the invoice total with a line-by-line breakdown.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is utilization?

Billable hours ÷ total hours worked (billable + non-billable). 75% means three of every four working hours earned money.

How is the invoice total built?

Billable amount (hours × rate) + expenses − discount. Each line is shown so you can verify it.

Should I round my hours?

Many freelancers round to 6-minute (0.1 h) increments. The tool accepts decimals, so enter whatever your contract specifies.
